context: We find in this book, that even those Jews who were scattered in the province of the heathen, were taken care of, and were wonderfully preserved, when threatened with destruction.

title: Esther 10: chapter overview
paragraphs: Greatness of Ahasuerus—Mordecai's advancement.

—Many instances of the grandeur of Ahasuerus might have been given: these were written in the Persian chronicles, which are long since lost, while the sacred writings will live till time shall be no more.
